problem:
Given that the minor of ${c}_{23}$ is $-86$, find all the possible values of $x$ in the matrix

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 7 & -1 \\ 4 & -4 & 5 \\ 11 & x & 6\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and third column:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 7 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & 5 \\ 11 & x & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

The minor of ${c}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}-3 & 7 \\ 11 & x\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}-3 & 7 \\ 11 & x\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-3)\cdot x-7\cdot 11 \\  & =-3x-77.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${c}_{23}$ is $-86$, so we must have:

$$
\begin{aligned}-3x-77 & =-86 \\ -3x & =-9 \\ x & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=3.$
